standing: Fictional delivery example for the carousel. No canonical Lab records, real owner decisions, grants, agent executions or test results are created or asserted.

definition.meaning: A product outcome that produces a saved export containing every required record identifier for a fixed snapshot, chosen account and declared filters.
definition.criterion: RequiredIds(S,A,F) subseteq OutputIds(E), equivalently no required IDs are missing.
definition.failure_condition: One or more required IDs are absent from E.

voices.formal: RequiredIds(S,A,F) = {r.id | r in Records(S), r.account = A, and for every f in F, f(r) is true}. CompleteIds(S,A,F,E) iff RequiredIds(S,A,F) subseteq OutputIds(E).
voices.plain: Use a database copy saved at one point in time. Select every entry for the chosen customer that matches every chosen filter. Every selected entry ID must appear in the exported file.
voices.domain: Operations analysts receive identifier coverage for their selected customer export.

definition.challenge_route: Ask the service owner to review evidence or propose a separately governed successor definition.
definition.presentation: The carousel shows a reader-facing definition sheet. This is not a schema-complete canonical Lab Definition or Product Capability instance.

required_ids_definition.meaning: The identifiers of every record in the fixed source snapshot whose account equals the chosen account and which satisfies every declared filter predicate.
required_ids_definition.formal: RequiredIds(S,A,F) = {r.id | r in Records(S), r.account = A, and for every f in F, f(r) is true}.
required_ids_definition.selection_rule: Select matching records from the full fixed source snapshot, then collect their stable record identifiers. Every filter must match. With no filters, all records for the chosen account qualify.
required_ids_definition.identifier_assumption: Each source record has one stable identifier, unique within this snapshot.
required_ids_definition.reference_boundary: Derive the required set from the source snapshot, not from the candidate export or a partial page of results.

acceptance.illustrative_decision: Service owner accepts exact definition v1 for use as the identifier-coverage assessment criterion.
acceptance.effect: Authority over meaning within the stated scope. No code conformance or agent action permission is inferred.

implementation_assignment.work: Produce candidate implementation I1 for this capability.
implementation_assignment.separate_permission: Edit candidate files and execute the fixed fixture within the declared workspace.

review_assignment.work: Assess exact implementation I1 and its saved output against definition v1.
review_assignment.separate_permission: Inspect selected source/build/output records, compare IDs and prepare review material.

fixture.excluded_source_records: Customer 1’s inactive records and active records belonging to another account fail the declared selection.
fixture.source_kind: database copy saved at one point in time
fixture.source_note: The agreed database copy is the fixed input. No live database access or new agent permissions are implied.

review.method: Required ID set minus saved output ID set
review.assessment: Fails ID-coverage criterion for this fixture.
review.standing: Illustrative review material, not an admitted Finding or acceptance decision.
review.reference_derivation: Select all Customer 1 records with active status from the fixed source snapshot. Collect their IDs independently of the saved export.

future_route: Revise implementation and gather fresh exact-target evidence
Obtain separate owner decision for exact implementation
